title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling

beats.event: Lives miserably with the Dursleys in Little Whinging
On his 11th birthday Hagrid arrives; he learns he is a wizard
Hagrid reveals Voldemort murdered his parents
Diagon Alley: buys wand and Hedwig; discovers his fame
On Hogwarts Express befriends Ron and meets Hermione
Sorting Hat places all three in Gryffindor
First Quidditch match: broom sabotaged but he wins
Discovers Mirror of Erised; sees his lost family
Learns Fluffy guards the Philosopher's Stone
Trio descends through trapdoor to defend the Stone
Confronts Quirrell/Voldemort; Stone appears in his pocket
Voldemort abandons Quirrell; Harry's touch burns Quirrell
Wakes in infirmary; Dumbledore explains mother's protection
Gryffindor wins House Cup; Harry heads home for summer
